title: MV3 CSP blocks new Function() → patch with safe closures in post-build
trigger: Emscripten/WASM library uses new Function() or Function() constructor — blocked by MV3 CSP script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'
principle: MV3 extension CSP blocks new Function() (unsafe-eval). Emscripten-generated code (OpenCV, ORT) uses Function() for named function wrappers, dynCall wrappers, and embind invoker/method callers. These don't actually need eval — they create closures from known arguments. Replace with explicit closure factories in a post-build patch script that does string replacement on the bundled JS.

cases.context: OpenCV Emscripten bundle uses Function() to create named function wrappers — EvalError in offscreen document
embind craftInvokerFunction uses new Function() to create invoker closures with arg type wiring — CSP blocks it

applyFor: Emscripten-generated code (OpenCV.js, ORT Web) in MV3 extensions
Any WASM library using Function() constructor for runtime wrappers
Sandboxed pages with strict CSP (no unsafe-eval)
Post-build patching strategy for third-party bundles with CSP violations
